llm_response.reason: The site displays multiple scam characteristics: false claims of guaranteed winnings and huge discounts; extremely broad and unfocused product offerings; misuse of legitimate brand names (Lazada); requests to download apps of unknown origin; all user actions (login, registration, chat) redirect to another suspicious domain; no verifiable business contact info or address; and psychological tactics such as 'full payment guarantee' and urgency bonuses. These patterns fit common Fake Online Shopping scams designed to phish, defraud, or install malware.
